mapper.select: SELECT t.team_id, t.name, t.consensus_rule, t.consensus_min_count, t.created_at, t.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM places p WHERE p.team_id = t.team_id) AS pin_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM places p WHERE p.team_id = t.team_id AND p.consensus_achieved_at IS NOT NULL) AS all_approved_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members m WHERE m.team_id = t.team_id) AS member_count FROM teams t JOIN team_members tm ON t.team_id = tm.team_id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT t.team_id, t.name, t.consensus_rule, t.consensus_min_count, t.created_at, t.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM places p WHERE p.team_id = t.team_id) AS pin_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM places p WHERE p.team_id = t.team_id AND p.consensus_achieved_at IS NOT NULL) AS all_approved_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members m WHERE m.team_id = t.team_id) AS member_count FROM teams t WHERE t.team_id = #{teamId}

SELECT tm.team_id, tm.user_id, COALESCE(u.login_id, tm.user_id::text) AS login_id, COALESCE(u.nickname, '멤버') AS nickname, tm.role, tm.color FROM team_members tm LEFT JOIN users u ON tm.user_id = u.user_id WHERE tm.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY (CASE WHEN tm.role = 'owner' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), tm.joined_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teams (name, consensus_rule, consensus_min_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, 'all', 2, now(), now())
INSERT INTO team_members (team_id, user_id, role, color, joined_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{color}, now()) ON CONFLICT (team_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT ti.invite_id, ti.team_id, t.name AS team_name, ti.code, ti.created_by, ti.expires_at, ti.revoked_at, ti.created_at FROM team_invites ti JOIN teams t ON ti.team_id = t.team_id WHERE ti.code = #{code} AND ti.revoked_at IS NULL AND (ti.expires_at IS NULL OR ti.expires_at > now()) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_invites (team_id, code, created_by, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{teamId}, #{code}, #{createdBy}, now() + interval '30 days', now()) ON CONFLICT (code) DO NOTHING
